topic: How does RAG help AI answer questions
title: 🤖 How Does RAG Help AI Answer Questions?
description: 🤖 RAG is the secret behind AI answers that actually cite sources. #shorts #ai #explained
narration: When you ask an AI a question, it normally guesses from what it memorized during training. But what if you need a real, sourced answer? That is where RAG comes in. RAG stands for Retrieval Augmented Generation. Instead of guessing, the AI first searches a database of real documents, like a student checking their notes before answering a test. It finds the most relevant passages and reads them. Then it uses those passages as context to generate an answer grounded in actual information. The key difference is that the AI is not making things up. It is quoting from real sources, which means you can verify what it says. Think of it like this: a regular AI is answering from memory, but a RAG-powered AI is answering with its textbook open.
